steps.domain_action: The Ineffable Father exists in silence before the All.
The Father moves to bring forth the first emanation, Jeu.
Jeu recognizes himself as the True God and head of the treasuries.
The light-spark is sent forth, separating the Pleroma from the matter below.
The chosen race receives the Word and begins the ascent to the Father.
The living Jesus teaches the apostles the hidden mysteries of the treasuries.
The disciples receive the seal of the Father, marking them as heavenly.
The earth is sent up to heaven as the understanding mind ceases to be earthly.
The archons and wicked powers are relegated to the land of darkness.
The Midst is established where the world is crucified and becomes nothing.
The dispersed members of the light are gathered into the one and only One.
The completion of the Pleroma is achieved in the eternal rest.
